part-2-s56.condition: Unit 2, Lesson 30. Progress check, part 2, с. 56. 1) Расскажи ученику лесной школы, что надо делать, чтобы быть здоровым. 2) Расспроси одноклассника о его привычках и посоветуй, что ещё делать.
steps: 1) You must wash your hands and face. You must clean your teeth every day. You must run and play in the park. You must eat fruit and vegetables. Don't eat many sweets and cakes. You must sleep well. You must play football or tennis.
2) — Do you clean your teeth every day? — Yes, I do. — Do you eat fruit? — No, I don't. — You must eat fruit and vegetables. Don't eat many sweets. You must sleep well.
part-2-s56.answer: 1) You must wash your hands and face, clean your teeth, run and play, eat fruit and vegetables, sleep well; don't eat many sweets. 2) — Do you clean your teeth every day? — Yes. — Do you eat fruit? — No. — You must eat fruit and vegetables!
